assertions.assertion: CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) was rendered
The patient presented with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry is clinically ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
Continuous monitoring is medically necessary to detect and correlate the palpitations and exertional dyspnea with any underlying arrhythmia, consistent with the clinical indication note
